messages:
customer-jane: Hi team — our client started getting 400 from POST /v1/rerank this morning after switching a legacy integration. Payload attached, reproducible with curl.

customer-jane: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-XXXX' -H 'Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-16' --data-binary $'\uFEFF{\n  \"items\": \"[{\\\"id\\\": \\\"a1\\\", \\\"text\\\": \\\"candidate\\\"}]\",\n  \"query\": \"which is best\"\n}'

alex-support: thanks — can you paste the exact server error (response body) and a full request/response dump if possible?

customer-jane: response body was: {"error":"Bad Request","message":"invalid request payload"} and curl exit code 3 sometimes. I can repro locally, looks like the items array becomes a string when the integration wraps it.

devin-eng: quick suspicion: charset=utf-16 + BOM will send UTF-16LE bytes. Our parsing layer expects UTF-8 text and then JSON. If the client included a BOM and the wrapper stringified the items array (items as a string) the server receives a JSON where items is a string not an array. That should be a 400 with a clearer message.

alex-support: can you run curl forcing UTF-8 to confirm? e.g., curl -H 'Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8' --data '{"items":[{"id":"a1","text":"candidate"}],"query":"which is best"}'

customer-jane: yep when I send with utf-8 and items as proper array it returns 200. So two issues: (1) the integration is sending charset utf-16, (2) it's also stringifying the items array into a JSON string.

ingest-bot: [sys] request-id=rid_01BWZQ3K log=parser.error detail="invalid JSON token at offset 2 (unexpected 0xFF)"

devin-eng: log confirms BOM -> parse fail. Two fixes: ask client to send UTF-8 or patch the proxy to convert charset. For the stringified-items case we already validate types and return 400. But agree error message could be clearer (currently generic).

alex-support: I'll send a repro and recommended client fix. Also opening an internal ops ticket to see if we can improve error text to detect non-utf8 BOMs and reply with guidance ("ensure UTF-8, ensure items is an array, not a string").

maria-ops: FYI I'm adding a small ingress filter rule to log Content-Type charsets for a week (for monitoring). If we see many utf-16 hits we can add an auto-convert.

customer-jane: thanks — for now we'll convert on our side. Appreciate the quick triage. :pray:

alex-support: marking resolved for customer-side workaround. Follow-up: ENG-6523 to improve 400 responses on rerank parsing with sample snippets. :thumbsup:
